# LoRA Hunt

> Hugging Face LoRA / PEFT adapter search and comparison index.

LoRA Hunt organizes public Hugging Face model metadata with purpose, compatibility, documentation quality, community reviews, and real-world runtime conditions.

NSFW and other content-warned Hub items remain searchable and are labeled in the adapter cards. Dataset metadata is indexed separately from LoRAs.

## Key pages

- [Adapter index](https://lora-hunt.info/): search and filter models.
- [Best Qwen3 LoRAs](https://lora-hunt.info/best/qwen3-loras): Qwen3 preset.
- [Best Japanese LoRAs](https://lora-hunt.info/best/japanese-loras): Japanese preset.
- [Best video LoRAs](https://lora-hunt.info/best/video-loras): video preset.
- [Qwen3-8B base models](https://lora-hunt.info/base/qwen3-8b): compatibility preset.
- [Datasets](https://lora-hunt.info/#datasets): training and evaluation datasets indexed separately from adapters.
- [Terms](https://lora-hunt.info/terms) and [Privacy](https://lora-hunt.info/privacy).

Model files remain hosted by the linked source. LoRA Hunt is an index and community review layer, not a license or quality guarantee.
